name: CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETINGS 6:00 PM AND 7:00 PM
minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETINGS 6:00 PM AND 7:00 PM
MINUTES
CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETINGS 6:00 PM AND 7:00 PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
OCTOBER 24, 2019
AGENDA NO. 1471
www.cityofpalmdale.org
1.
CALL TO ORDER 6:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION SPECIAL MEETING.
Mayor Hofbauer called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
PRESENT:
Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
ABSENT:
None.
3.
PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM 4.1:
Public Comments: None.
4.
PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
City Attorney Ditzhazy stated that the item would be heard as listed.
4.1
The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of a Council discussion and to confer with the City Attorney and Personnel Manager in connection with the pending retirement of City Manager, Jim Purtee, including a discussion of replacement of the city manager.
This closed session is necessary because a public discussion of this item, prior to a complete discussion by the Council of a course of action to replace the city manager, would be prejudicial to the City.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6.
5.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed Session was held from 6:02 p.m. to 6:25 p.m.
6.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
The Mayor and all City Council Members were present.
Item 4.1 CC – Confer regarding replacement of Retiring City Manager / Personnel Matters – In closed session the City Council discussed replacement of retiring City Manager Purtee. The City Council voted unanimously to enter into contract negotiations with Assistant City Manager Murphy to replace City Manager Purtee as the City's new city manager. Mayor Hofbauer, City Attorney Ditzhazy and Human Resources Manager Nevarez will discuss and formalize the terms and conditions of the proposed contract with Assistant City Manager Murphy. The proposed contract will be brought back to the City Council as soon as practicable. No further reportable action at this time.
7.
ADJOURN 6:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION SPECIAL MEETING.
Mayor Hofbauer adjourned the meeting at 6:32 p.m.
8.
CALL TO ORDER 7:00 P.M. SPECIAL MEETING.
Mayor Hofbauer called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.
9.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10.
ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
PRESENT:
Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
ABSENT:
None.
11.
PUBLIC COMMENTS CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM 12.1 AND SPECIAL REPORT ITEM 13.1:
Mayor Hofbauer asked Planning Commissioners and General Plan Advisory Committee (GPAC) Members to stand and introduce themselves. In attendance were Planning Commissioner Nemeth; GPAC members Laura Gordon; Jason Zink; Deborah Rutkowski-Hines; Pat Hunt; Lourdes Everett; Theresa Hambro; and Juan Blanco.
Mayor Hofbauer stated that Planning Commission and GPAC members were there for the Regional Housing Needs Assessment presentation.
Jason Zink spoke about consent calendar and non-agenda public comments being separated on the agenda.
Planning Commissioner Nemeth introduced Planning Commissioner Henderson.
Susan Reyna stated she enjoyed being at the meeting.
12.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
12.1
Adopt Resolution No. CC 2019-087, A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palmdale ratifying the City Manager’s approval of Purchase Order # 20200311 with Crayon Software Experts, LLC for the Purchase of Microsoft Enterprise Licensing and execution of Agreement No. A-6792 between the City of Palmdale and Microsoft Corporation. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Motion: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2019-087.
Moved by Juan Carrillo,
seconded by Austin Bishop.
Vote: Motion carried (5-0)
Yes: Steven Hofbauer, Austin Bishop, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
13.
SPECIAL REPORT:
13.1
Regional Housing Needs Assessment Update. (Staff Reference: Director of Economic and Community Development Services Oyler)
Planning Manager Bruce spoke regarding the Regional Housing Needs Assessment and presented a PowerPoint.
There was Council discussion regarding this item.
City Attorney Ditzhazy spoke regarding the need for financing.
City Manager Purtee stated that he was glad that the Council, Planning Commission and GPAC members were present and spoke about the different roles each group has in the Regional Housing Needs Assessment process.
Jason Zink spoke about funding and the need for legislative assistance.
14.
ADJOURN 7:00 P.M. SPECIAL MEETING.
Mayor Hofbauer adjourned the meeting at 7:50 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 3rd day of December 2019.
_______________________
Steven D. Hofbauer, Mayor
ATTEST:
________________________
Rebecca J. Smith, City Clerk
